graph_nodes.name: read_project_manifest
examples: (TC-B100-18, test_tc_b100_18_valid_gathered_is_an_equal_dict) gathered {"patches": ["patches/boost.json"]} → manifest.gathered equal dict, 0 issues (holds at dc3b314)
